title: Tricky Trapdoors!
description: Adds trapdoors with textures of common blocks, perfect for secret entrances!
body:
**Tricky Trapdoors! **Adds trapdoors for:
- Wool
- Concrete
- Some Stone variants(MORE COMING!)

Crafting Recipes can be found in the Recipe Book and are unlocked by obtaining any plank type!

This mod was mainly created for me and my friends but sharing is caring! Right?

Got any suggestions or bug reports? Contact me here: Discord: fikon1 Mail: ffeelliixx479@gmail.com
